stories.title: US has no idea of how long its economic pressure on Iran will take — Vance
stories.summary: NEW YORK, August 21. US Vice President J D Vance de-facto admitted that he has no idea for how long he will have to implement US President Donald Trump’s campaign of economic pressure on Iran. During an interview with the Newsmax TV channel was asked for how long, in his opinion, Iran will be able to withstand economic pressure. "You know, it's always tough to predict that, and that's honestly not really our focus," Vance said. "They're under a ton of pressure. That pressure is conducive to our goal of ensuring they don't have a nuclear weapon, whether they can survive a couple of weeks or a couple of months or possibly longer," the US vice president added. Earlier, US President Donald Trump announced the beginning of the "most crushing economic operation" against Iran. He also warned that countries whose financial institutions, businesses, airports or government entities support Tehran would face serious economic consequences from the United States. According to Trump, Washington needs all its allies to side with the United States.

stories.title: Genesis' cumulative U.S. sales surpass 450,000 units
stories.summary: Genesis, Hyundai Motor Group's independent luxury brand, said Friday its cumulative sales in the United States have surpassed 450,000 units, a decade after entering the world's largest auto market. Genesis said it had sold 454,049 vehicles in the U.S. as of July since its official launch in 2016. The brand's annual U.S. sales surpassed 80,000 units for the first time last year, while first-half sales reached a record 39,088 units this year. The strong performance was driven by solid demand for its sport utility vehicle (SUV) lineup, which accounted for 61.5 percent of cumulative U.S. sales. Genesis said it plans to launch the GV90 and GV60 Magma in the U.S. and add hybrid variants to its existing lineup, further expanding its portfolio of luxury, electrified and hybrid models. Genesis unveiled the GV90, its flagship electric SUV, at its world premiere in San Francisco on Wednesday. The model is scheduled to be launched in the fourth quarter of this year.
